description: Machine-readable requirement-to-test manifest for Wave A (Stage J4C semantic contract + Stage J4D durable write invariant), separate from the frozen J4B.3 manifest.

requirements.title: Raw observation vs governed conclusion separation
requirements.expected_behavior: A numerical crossing observation (J4B) is never by itself treated as a governed touch conclusion; classify_governed_level_touch only returns SUPPORTED_TOUCH when the level history is GOVERNED_UNMODIFIED.

requirements.title: Level-history status matrix
requirements.expected_behavior: NULL/legacy-FALSE/governed-FALSE/TRUE/invalid-combination/unsupported-version are classified into the five distinct statuses per Gate 1C.

requirements.title: Per-level independence
requirements.expected_behavior: Target and stop level-history status are evaluated independently; an order conclusion requires BOTH levels GOVERNED_UNMODIFIED, not the aggregate flag.

requirements.title: Endpoint evidence matrix
requirements.expected_behavior: Entry/exit snapshot presence and value combinations (missing/null/value/identical/different/malformed/non-finite) are classified per Gate 1E, never conflated with a governed-history claim.

requirements.title: Price-basis eligibility
requirements.expected_behavior: UNADJUSTED is COMPATIBLE; SPLIT_ADJUSTED/TOTAL_RETURN_ADJUSTED are INCOMPATIBLE; UNKNOWN_ADJUSTMENT is UNKNOWN; anything else is CORRUPT_OR_CONTRADICTORY; None is EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE.

requirements.title: Governed touch conclusion
requirements.expected_behavior: No value/no crossing/supported/incompatible-basis/no-bars/insufficient-evidence are the only reachable statuses per Gate 1H.

requirements.title: Governed order conclusion
requirements.expected_behavior: Neither/target-only/stop-only/target-before-stop/stop-before-target/same-bar-unknown/unavailable are the only reachable statuses per Gate 1I.

requirements.title: Same-bar ambiguity
requirements.expected_behavior: Both values safely observed on the same bar never produces an inferred order -- SAME_BAR_ORDER_UNKNOWN always.

requirements.title: Partial-boundary limits
requirements.expected_behavior: Partial-boundary-only evidence never produces a definitive order conclusion.

requirements.title: Exact canonical fallback
requirements.expected_behavior: Every fallback conclusion uses the exact sentence 'Insufficient evidence to determine this factor reliably.', enforced by dataclass construction, never paraphrased.

requirements.title: No-fabrication
requirements.expected_behavior: No prohibited-claim source strings; endpoint equality alone and legacy null/null never make throughout-trade absence eligible; only a governed-unmodified level with null/null endpoints does.

requirements.title: Old/new model transition boundary (non-wiring)
requirements.expected_behavior: detect_touches/classify_touch_order (pre-J4C model) remain byte-for-byte unchanged by this Wave; the new J4C modules have no report/claim/API/frontend caller.

requirements.title: Invariant version identity
requirements.expected_behavior: Version is immutable once set on a row; NULL never silently upgrades via an ordinary edit; an unsupported version fails closed.

requirements.title: New-trade initialization
requirements.expected_behavior: A new governed trade explicitly initializes version='1', both per-level flags FALSE, aggregate FALSE -- never NULL.

requirements.title: Legacy preservation
requirements.expected_behavior: A legacy row (version NULL) is never backfilled; a directly observed legacy edit may set a per-level flag TRUE without inventing a version.

requirements.title: Per-level monotonicity
requirements.expected_behavior: stop_modified_after_entry/target_modified_after_entry TRUE can never revert to FALSE or NULL.

requirements.title: Aggregate/per-level consistency
requirements.expected_behavior: levels_modified_after_entry must be TRUE whenever either per-level flag is TRUE; a per-level TRUE without the matching aggregate is rejected.

requirements.title: No-op edit behavior
requirements.expected_behavior: A no-op edit (resubmitted-identical or omitted-field-preserved value) leaves every per-level and aggregate flag untouched -- never writes FALSE.

requirements.title: Add/change/clear behavior
requirements.expected_behavior: A genuine stop/target add, change, or explicit clear sets the matching per-level flag and aggregate TRUE, independently for stop vs target.

requirements.title: Database enforcement (bypass resistance)
requirements.expected_behavior: A governed value change without the matching per-level flag TRUE in the same statement is rejected by the trigger regardless of caller; an unrelated update is never misclassified as a level modification.

requirements.title: Concurrency
requirements.expected_behavior: Concurrent stop-only and target-only edits, and concurrent identical edits, cannot lose a positive TRUE evidence write -- proven only via real PostgreSQL row locking, never a mocked connection.

requirements.title: Authorization
requirements.expected_behavior: A cross-user edit is rejected (403) without mutating any governed field; a nonexistent trade is rejected (404) indistinguishably in shape from the cross-user case.

requirements.title: Entry/exit snapshots
requirements.expected_behavior: The exit snapshot's level_history_contract_version/final_stop_modified_after_entry/final_target_modified_after_entry/levels_modified_after_entry are populated from the governed paper_trades row read under the same row lock as the close UPDATE -- fixing the prior gap where levels_modified_after_entry was always NULL.

requirements.title: Reset
requirements.expected_behavior: Reset removes only the requesting user's governed trade rows; another user's governed trade is untouched.

requirements.title: Schema idempotency
requirements.expected_behavior: Re-running the full schema script (including the new columns, CHECK constraint, and trigger) against an already-migrated database is a no-op, never an error.

requirements.title: Entry-snapshot governed fields
requirements.expected_behavior: A new governed buy stores level_history_contract_version='1' and all three initial per-level/aggregate flags FALSE in paper_trade_entry_snapshot; a legacy snapshot stays NULL for all four; the table remains immutable-by-UPDATE; schema re-init is idempotent; no existing row is backfilled.

requirements.title: Snapshot schema-version coexistence
requirements.expected_behavior: Every new entry/exit snapshot stamps 1.1.0; a pre-existing 1.0.0 row remains readable and untouched alongside a new 1.1.0 row for a different trade.

requirements.title: Explicit transaction boundary
requirements.expected_behavior: edit_trade wraps its full read-modify-write in an explicit conn.transaction(), so the FOR UPDATE row lock is actually held under the autocommit=True pool -- proven indirectly by the deterministic concurrency and rollback tests below (a transaction-less implementation could not pass either).

requirements.title: Deterministic concurrent stop+target preservation
requirements.expected_behavior: A row lock explicitly held open on a separate real connection forces genuine overlap between two concurrent editors; both survive, final stop_loss/target_price equal the submitted values, both per-level flags and the aggregate are TRUE. Concurrent identical edits remain idempotent.

requirements.title: Transaction rollback
requirements.expected_behavior: A genuine PostgreSQL error on the entry-price cash-adjustment statement (the last statement in the transaction) rolls back the earlier stop/target UPDATE in the same transaction -- both trade state and portfolio cash are preserved exactly as before the request.

requirements.title: Exact governed tuple consistency
requirements.expected_behavior: For a governed version '1' row, stop_modified_after_entry/target_modified_after_entry/levels_modified_after_entry must all be NOT NULL and the aggregate must equal exactly the logical OR of the two per-level flags -- not merely 'per-level TRUE implies aggregate TRUE'.

requirements.title: INSERT enforcement of the exact governed tuple
requirements.expected_behavior: Every invalid governed tuple (FALSE/FALSE/TRUE, FALSE/FALSE/NULL, TRUE/FALSE/FALSE, FALSE/TRUE/FALSE, NULL/FALSE/FALSE, FALSE/NULL/FALSE, partial NULL, unsupported version) is rejected on INSERT.

requirements.title: UPDATE enforcement of the exact governed tuple
requirements.expected_behavior: An UPDATE that would produce an invalid governed tuple (aggregate TRUE with both per-level FALSE, aggregate reset to FALSE while a per-level flag is TRUE, mutating a supported version) is rejected.

requirements.title: Cross-user/nonexistent indistinguishability
requirements.expected_behavior: Owner+existing succeeds; owner+nonexistent and other-user+existing return the IDENTICAL stable 404 result; market/status differences never create an existence oracle; a rejected edit mutates nothing.

requirements.title: Endpoint-aware touch eligibility
requirements.expected_behavior: Missing/malformed endpoint evidence always falls back; governed-unmodified with null/null endpoints falls back (no level configured throughout); SUPPORTED_TOUCH requires identical non-null endpoints consistent with the observed crossing value.

requirements.title: Endpoint-aware order eligibility
requirements.expected_behavior: An ordered conclusion requires BOTH levels to independently pass endpoint-aware eligibility; contradictory evidence for either level forces ORDER_UNAVAILABLE even when both levels are GOVERNED_UNMODIFIED and a safe order pattern exists.

requirements.title: Governed contradiction handling
requirements.expected_behavior: A GOVERNED_UNMODIFIED level whose endpoints show a difference (differing values, null-to-value, value-to-null) is CONTRADICTORY_ENDPOINT_EVIDENCE, distinct from the generic INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE fallback.

requirements.title: Exact-type/hostile-subclass hardening
requirements.expected_behavior: str/int/float subclasses, bools in numeric positions, and whitespace-only strings are all rejected via exact type() checks rather than isinstance, across classify_level_history_status, classify_endpoint_evidence, classify_price_basis_eligibility, and the two conclusion dataclasses.

requirements.title: Legacy snapshot and row preservation
requirements.expected_behavior: A legacy entry snapshot and its linked legacy paper_trades row are never backfilled by re-running schema init; a 1.0.0-versioned snapshot remains readable unchanged alongside new 1.1.0 rows.

requirements.title: Canonical level-kind validation
requirements.expected_behavior: level_kind must be an exact str, non-whitespace, member of {TARGET_VALUE, STOP_VALUE} only -- validated at both classify_governed_level_touch entry and direct GovernedLevelTouchConclusion construction. A garbage value is rejected, never stored verbatim.

requirements.title: Exact governed classifier input types
requirements.expected_behavior: bars_available must be an exact bool (a hostile int subclass rejected); observation must be exactly NumericalLevelCrossingObservation; summary must be exactly ObservedNumericalCrossingSummary; level_history_status/price_basis_status must be exact str members of their canonical sets -- all via type() is, not isinstance.

requirements.title: Target-only full eligibility
requirements.expected_behavior: TARGET_ONLY_OBSERVED requires the target side SUPPORTED and the stop side a definitive negative (no value supplied, or no crossing under GOVERNED_UNMODIFIED history); unknown/legacy history, missing entry/exit snapshot, or endpoint contradiction on the stop side all force ORDER_UNAVAILABLE.

requirements.title: Stop-only full eligibility
requirements.expected_behavior: STOP_ONLY_OBSERVED requires the exact symmetric rule to WA-C17 for the stop/target sides reversed.

requirements.title: Same-bar full eligibility
requirements.expected_behavior: SAME_BAR_ORDER_UNKNOWN requires BOTH per-level governed touch conclusions SUPPORTED; either side's history-unknown, missing endpoint, or endpoint contradiction forces ORDER_UNAVAILABLE.

requirements.title: Neither-observed full eligibility
requirements.expected_behavior: A definitive NEITHER_OBSERVED requires complete, noncontradictory evidence (a definitive negative) for both sides; missing/legacy/contradictory/malformed evidence for either side must not be converted into a confident neither conclusion.

requirements.title: Shared touch/order eligibility path
requirements.expected_behavior: classify_governed_order derives each side's eligibility via classify_governed_level_touch itself -- the exact same function used standalone -- never a second, independently-implemented eligibility path. Ordered and same-bar patterns require both per-level touches SUPPORTED; single-sided/neither-observed patterns are decided via _side_is_trustworthy/_side_is_definitive_negative, which (per WA-C25) consume only the resulting conclusion, never raw level-history/endpoint/basis inputs a second time.

requirements.title: Invalid-status rejection
requirements.expected_behavior: An invalid or subclassed status/detail combination raises GovernedConclusionContractError with a stable reason code -- never silently converted into a normal fallback conclusion; a positive status may not use the canonical fallback sentence as its detail.

requirements.title: Final-HEAD non-PostgreSQL assurance
requirements.expected_behavior: The corrected governed-order eligibility design remains fully unwired (no report/claim/API/frontend caller) and internally consistent (the order classifier's per-level result agrees with the standalone touch classifier for identical inputs, and never reinterprets raw level-history after the two per-level conclusions are built) at the final single-source-eligibility closure-correction HEAD.

requirements.title: No-crossing requires governed-unmodified history
requirements.expected_behavior: GOVERNED_TOUCH_NO_COMPATIBLE_CROSSING (a definitive governed negative) is returned only when level_history_status is exactly LEVEL_HISTORY_STATUS_GOVERNED_UNMODIFIED. No-crossing under unknown/legacy, modified-after-entry, or contradictory history returns GOVERNED_TOUCH_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with the exact canonical fallback sentence instead. NO_VALUE_SUPPLIED remains independent of history status under all three families.

requirements.title: Order uses conclusion-only eligibility
requirements.expected_behavior: The definitive-negative/trustworthy helpers accept exactly one parameter (the GovernedLevelTouchConclusion itself) -- no raw level_history_status, endpoint value, snapshot flag, price-basis status, bars-available flag, or observation is consulted after the per-level conclusion is constructed. Target-only, stop-only, and neither-observed order conclusions are decided solely from the resulting conclusion status.
